about.label: Get to know me
about.title: About
about.subtitle: FullStack Developer passionate about building performant, maintainable and user-centred digital solutions.
about.bio_p1: I'm Raoudha Fathallah, a FullStack Developer with over 4 years of experience designing and building web and mobile applications. My journey has taken me from complex ERP projects to modern SaaS platforms, always with a focus on quality and performance.
about.bio_p2: Specialised in the Microsoft ecosystem (.NET Core, .NET 8, C#, Blazor) on the backend, and in modern frameworks (Angular, React, Next.js) on the frontend, I work across all stages of the software lifecycle: design, development, testing and deployment. I've contributed to transport management (WMS/TMS/CRM), ERP, production planning (GPAO) and online seminar platforms.
about.bio_p3: Curious and self-driven, I stay constantly up to date with technology. I work in Agile/Scrum methodology and place great importance on communication and team collaboration. My goal: turning complex business needs into elegant digital experiences.
about.val1_desc: Clean, tested, documented code — committed to long-term maintainability.
about.val2_desc: Agile teamwork, transparent communication and knowledge sharing.
about.val3_desc: Constant learning, certifications and active tech watch.
about.exp0_desc: Development of Teleseminar, an online seminar platform, and Kwabb. Built dynamic interfaces with Blazor and React/Next.js, robust APIs with .NET 8, live session management, subscription system and member portal.
about.exp1_desc: Developed three major products: Flex Transport (WMS/TMS/CRM with Google Maps real-time delivery tracking), SMTP (complete ERP: sales, accounting, HR, logistics) and AEI GPAO (industrial production planning software). Heavy use of .NET Core, Angular and Azure DevOps.
about.exp2_desc: Design and development of a job matching platform in Laravel: algorithmic matching between job offers and candidate profiles, recruiter portal, analytics dashboard and real-time notifications.
about.exp3_desc: Developed software solutions for Golden Group Four and Come Canada. Built management interfaces and business modules in C# / .NET, reports and dashboards.
about.exp4_desc: Development and maintenance of web applications for the centre's internal management. PHP modules, MySQL database management and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend development.
about.exp5_desc: Management and content creation for the IPTV channel website: SEO optimisation, video player integration, media management and WordPress administration.
about.exp6_desc: Final year project: native Android mobile application development in Java. UI design, REST API integration, local persistence with SQLite and Play Store deployment.
about.edu0_desc: Cloud architecture, virtualisation, containerisation, advanced software development and Big Data.
about.edu1_desc: Information systems, databases, object-oriented programming and software engineering.
about.edu2_desc: Computer science track specialising in algorithms and operating systems.
about.cta_desc: Open to freelance, full-time roles or collaboration on innovative projects.
